affected_subject.reason: Identifies disputeToken, disputeTree(), resolveDispute(), and disputer state as affected components.

trigger_or_action.reason: Concrete trigger: FoT token configured as disputeToken and user calls disputeTree(), then resolveDispute() is invoked.

direct_effect.reason: resolveDispute() reverts on transfer exceeding balance, leaving disputer non-zero and dispute unresolvable.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Conservation/state-transition relation: recorded disputeAmount exceeds actual received balance, so recorded amount cannot be transferred back, violating expected resolution success.

summary: Report explains affected functions/state, FoT-token trigger, revert and permanent disputer lock effect, and the balance-vs-recorded-amount conservation basis, sufficient to attempt P/I/V formalization.
